static_traits.name: Li Jie
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, living with a cat
static_traits.social_status: Preferring to be alone, lacking a strong support system, few relationships with others
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no similar psychological problems appeared in the past; has not yet received psychotherapy or counseling
static_traits.language_features: Able to clearly express troubles and concrete situations, fairly cooperative; rather negative tone, repeated self-denial and worry; showing obvious anxiety and some avoidance

basic_info.main_problem: I keep worrying that cafe customers see me as sloppy because of cat hair on my clothes; this thought makes me feel pressured and anxious.
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent worry and anxiety are affecting my work performance and overall physical and mental health, so I am seeking counseling to improve this.
growth_experiences: A few months ago, a customer made an offhand comment about cat hair on my uniform; since then I have repeatedly had the thought 'they will think I am sloppy' when interacting with customers, with gradually worsening anxiety; I tried 'downplaying the comment' and using a lint roller to clean my clothes, but the worry and automatic thoughts persist; this affects work performance, sleep and self-care.

First time needing to sell owned land; lacking relevant experience, producing strong self-doubt and fear of negotiation; avoiding and procrastinating whenever thinking of negotiating and contacting potential buyers; although trying consulting friends and reading negotiation techniques, still feeling more unbearable and overwhelmed, further reinforcing the cognition 'I am not good enough and will fail'.

core_beliefs: My self-worth depends on others' approval and evaluation

special_situations.event: When interacting with customers at a cafe, notices cat hair on her clothes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others see my clothes are not clean, they will deem me sloppy and negate me as a person
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Using a lint roller, trying to hide cat hair, over-focusing on customers' reactions and expressions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Customers must think I look sloppy

special_situations.event: A few months ago a customer made a casual comment about cat hair on my uniform
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others point out my inadequacies, it means I am generally not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly ruminating on the comment, trying to avoid being judged again by cleaning clothes harder
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: What they said is true; I am just not decent enough

special_situations.event: Thinking about having to interact with customers before each shift
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only a flawless appearance can be recognized; once imperfect, one will be rejected or looked down upon
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly checks and cleans clothes before the shift, or has thoughts of avoiding work
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If cat hair appears, today will definitely be terrible

special_situations.event: Thinking about needing to negotiate with potential buyers to sell land
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the negotiation is unsuccessful or I am rejected, it proves I am not good enough and I will be humiliated
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Procrastinates and avoids contacting buyers, only does indirect preparation (consulting friends, reading materials)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will fail, no one will buy, I am not good enough

core_conflict.wish: Craves positive evaluation, acceptance, and recognition
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being rejected, humiliated and negated
defense_goal: Through avoidance and maintaining a perfect image, reducing the risk of being judged and anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: Not good enough, a party easily judged by others
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh judges or potential rejecters (customers / buyers)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking about selling the land and needing to negotiate with buyers
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Unconsciously views potential buyers as authoritative judges who will reject and humiliate her
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing 'I am not ready yet / this is my first time' in a gentle but hesitant tone, steering the topic toward information gathering and preparation, avoiding committing to concrete actions.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When noticing cat hair on clothes in the cafe or hearing customers comment about cat hair
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interpreting customers' neutral or offhand comments as negative judgments and negation of one's character
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Quickly apologizing and explaining, emphasizing 'I will handle it right away', while repeatedly using a lint roller to clean clothes, to reduce guilt and anxiety.

manifestations: Preferring to be alone, lacking a strong support system, often burying worries and troubles without sharing with others
outcomes: In interpersonal situations, relies more on others' evaluations to confirm self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequent self-denial ('I am not good enough')
Excessively worrying about others' evaluations, repeatedly checking and hesitating before contacting customers or potential buyers

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Projecting one's own shame and worry as 'Customers must think I look sloppy'
In the land-sale situation, presupposes 'they will reject me'

positive_force: Has some communication and persuasion ability, transferable to negotiation settings
Willing to seek professional counseling and support, open to exploration and trying
Having taken concrete actions (using a lint roller, trying to downplay the comment) shows problem-solving willingness
Able to propose a 'small-step attempt' approach (informal contact first to test the waters)
negative_force: Excessive reliance on external evaluation to affirm self-worth
Significant cognitive biases (mind reading, overgeneralization, predicting the future)
Weak social support, tending to be alone, difficulty obtaining emotional and instrumental support
Avoidance and procrastination maintain and worsen problems
Anxiety affecting sleep and self-care, further weakening coping resources

target_behavior.behavior: When thinking of selling land and needing to negotiate, avoidance and procrastination appear
antecedent: Facing negotiation situations and uncertain outcomes
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing failure and being rejected, lacking confidence in negotiation skills, and thereby validating the core belief 'I am not good enough'
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential failure and shame, temporarily reducing anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Transaction progress blocked; persistent anxiety and decreased self-efficacy; problem prolonged

target_behavior.behavior: Obsessive worry about others' evaluations and significant anxiety when interacting with customers
antecedent: Noticing cat hair on clothing or recalling customers' related comments
target_behavior.core_reason: Self-worth highly dependent on others' approval, accompanied by mind-reading and future-predicting cognitive biases
target_behavior.function: Through vigilance and self-checking, tries to avoid negative evaluation
target_behavior.consequence: Work performance affected, sleep disturbance and declining self-care, reinforcing a negative cycle
